minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  January 25, 2021

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was a call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833; Meeting  ID:
930 6807 0669 Passcode: 950583 at 11:35 am.

  Members Present:  Peggy Velasquez, Finance Department
  Derald Brenneman City Attorney’s Office
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s Office

  Staff Present:  Stephanie Maldonado, Parks and Recreation
  Dominique Ybarra, Finance Department
  Josh Howe. ITC Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Peggy Velasquez reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of December 07, 2020, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. ProxyClick Software – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing services for
  all departments in the amount of $3,672.00. Motion carried unanimously.

3. A-Throne Co., Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing portable
  restrooms and sinks for the public at Rogers Park in the amount of $4,576.13. Motion carried
  unanimously.

4. Alta Environmental, L.P – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  asbestos removal services in the amount of $6,066.00. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Peggy Velasquez reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting
adjourned at 11:41 a.m. Adjournment
